title: Full Stack Engineer
description: We build the backends for our own products and our clients' — from the first architectural decision all the way to production. In this role you own services end to end: schema design, API contracts, deployment, and the documentation that lets the next person take over without asking you. Let's be upfront about the stack. Our default for product backends is NestJS + TypeScript, and that's where you'll spend most of your time. Express shows up in older services and lightweight internal tools; FastAPI/Django come in for ML endpoints and compute-heavy work. If you've never written NestJS but you're strong in TypeScript and you understand layered backend architecture, this role fits you. If your experience is almost entirely on the Python side, this will largely be unfamiliar ground — and we'd rather say that now than in your second month. What you'll do Design and build services in NestJS + TypeScript: strict types, typed error contracts, a repository layer that keeps database access in one place Model data and own migrations properly — including the boring parts: reversibility, two versions running side by side during a deploy, not breaking a live client Ship to production yourself: containerize, deploy, watch the logs, fix what you broke Move to the frontend when a feature needs it (Next.js, React) — don't throw the API over the wall and walk away Write docs a new developer can follow without asking you Mentor Neon Academy interns in review sessions The five things we look for 3+ years of production backend with Node.js + TypeScript. Framework details are learnable; understanding why a layer exists is not Strong SQL and data modeling — you can explain why a schema is built the way it is Docker in practice — multi-stage builds, small images, a local environment close to production Cloud deployment experience (GCP or AWS) — depth in one and willingness to learn the other is enough You write things down — an undocumented feature is a feature only you can touch Nice to have, not disqualifying FastAPI/Django · Terraform · Redis and queues (BullMQ, Celery) · logging and alerting · Cloud Run/ECS/Fargate · Next.js App Router · writing APIs for Flutter clients How we work Branch, PR, review, merge — no direct commits to main, CI gates the merge Documentation is part of "done"; a PR without a readable explanation goes back We use AI agents and expect you to as well — but we also expect you to review their output the way you'd review a junior's code. An agent's answer is a draft, not a decision Every decision has a reason; review asks "why," and "it works" is not an answer we accept on its own What you don't need A CS degree · a big-company background · every item on the list above · native-level English (enough to read technical docs and join a client call is plenty). Process Apply → short call → technical interview on a system you've built → team meet. Bring something real to the technical interview; we'll ask why you made specific decisions and what you'd do differently today.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description: Hesap positions itself as Turkey’s next-generation financial product comparison platform. It is an AI-powered, one-stop financial platform that enables individuals to make informed financial decisions by providing seamless access to the most competitive banking and financial products — including loans, credit cards, deposit options, electronic money solutions, open banking, and investment products — all within a single platform. Powered by AI-driven, real-time data and insights, Hesap delivers personalized financial recommendations through an integrated network of financial institutions, ensuring a transparent, efficient, and superior user experience. We are looking for Senior Backend Developer (Kotlin/Java) to join our dynamic and fast-paced team. To build a best-in-class fintech platform, you will work with product managers, QA engineers, backend, frontend, and mobile developers. What do we expect from you? Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, mathematics, or other related fields, Minimum 5 years experience in backend software development Strong understanding of software development methodologies, Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues and solve problems efficiently, Effective communication skills Expert knowledge of object-oriented concepts and technologies such as software architectures, design patterns Professional experience with Kotlin or Java (willingness to learn Kotlin is a plus!). If you have strong Java experience and a willingness to learn Kotlin, we would love to hear from you Experience with Spring (Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, etc.) Hands-on experience with API design Experience with relational databases like PostgreSQL, Oracle, etc. Experience with NoSQL databases like MongoDB, Redis, Couchbase, etc. Experience with message queues like Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc. Experience with container technologies like Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, etc. Experience with cloud platforms like GCP, AWS, Azure, or Huawei Cloud Knowledge on distributed systems and microservice architecture is a plus Strong desire to learn and explore innovative technologies What will you do when you join us? Work within an agile team to define, design, build and ship new features and extend existing ones Analyze requirements and constraints, propose innovative solutions, and evaluate their impact on business goals Collaborate with your team and business stakeholders to develop solutions that maximize customer value and drive continuous improvement Write clean, maintainable code with unit tests and participate in peer code-reviews Contribute to implement the software engineering best practices for the full software development life cycle including software design, coding standards, code reviews, test processes, deployment strategies, and maintenance Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of our development processes and engineering culture Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends, applying them to enhance our projects Your personal data is shared with our company, Hesap Bilgi Hizmetleri ve Teknoloji A.Ş ., as the data controller, in order to carry out the recruitment process. title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Şirket Hakkında Safahat.ai, hukuk süreçlerini yapay zekâ ile uçtan uca otomatikleştiren bir hukuk teknolojisi şirketidir. İcra takibi, dava süreçleri ve sözleşme otomasyonunu kapsayan platformumuz, kurumsal müşterilerin kendi veri merkezlerinde tamamen on-premises olarak çalışacak şekilde tasarlanmıştır. LLM tabanlı sistemleri buluta dokunmadan, müşteri altyapısında güvenle çalıştırmak gibi sektörde az sayıda ekibin uğraştığı bir problem alanında derinleşiyoruz. Türkiye'de kurulduk; hedefimiz global. Pozisyon Hakkında Çekirdek mühendislik ekibimize katılacak, geliştirdiği özelliği veri modelinden arayüzüne kadar sahiplenecek bir yazılım geliştirici arıyoruz. Sorumluluklar Hangfire tabanlı arka plan senkronizasyon motorunu geliştirmek ve dayanıklı hâle getirmek.
